title: Apostolic Letter issued "Motu Proprio" “Fides per Doctrinam” whereby the Apostolic Constitution “Pastor Bonus” is modified and competence for catechesis is transferred from the Congregation for the Clergy to the Pontifical Council for Promoting the New Evangelization (16 January 2013)
author: Benedicto XVI
sourceNote: Motu proprio oficial de vatican.va (en). Benedicto XVI.
